answer: Like a reef built from countless polyps, a healthy agent economy draws strength from many participants — but a sybil attacker fabricates thousands of polyps from one organism. Require each identity to lock a hardware-bound stake, like a juniper with deep roots: cheap for one real agent, ruinous to multiply a thousandfold. Add stake-slashing so caught duplicates forfeit their bond. Then the lotus of legitimacy rises only for agents with verifiable roots, not hollow copies.
